query: Arm Neoverse CPU deployed count 1 billion data center hyperscaler AWS
normalized: 1 arm aws billion center count cpu data deployed hyperscaler neoverse

output.content:
Arm reported on February 4, 2026, that cumulative **Arm Neoverse deployments had surpassed 1 billion CPU cores**; this is a cores-shipped/deployed milestone across customers, **not a count of 1 billion AWS deployments alone**. [[1]] 

AWS is one of the principal hyperscaler adopters: Arm specifically noted that AWS launched its fifth-generation Graviton processor with **192 cores**, twice Graviton4’s core count. [[2]]
